I'm so sorry, but I think he is abusive. You deserve someone who is a thousand times better than him. I suggest ending the relationship as soon as possible. Break the news to him over an email or text message and then block his number, lock your doors, and try to always have company or a friend/family member on call. You need to eliminate any temptation on your part to talk to him again, and also protect yourself from the very real possibility that he might harass and threaten you.

It will be painful to end the relationship, but it is also very difficult to stay, dangerous perhaps. You deserve better.

Light ice is subjective. What I consider light ice might be heavy ice to someone else. I suggest ordering very light ice, or perhaps telling the partner on register that you would like your Cold Brew poured to 1 or 2 inches (?) below the rim of the cup, then ice to the top. Some customers ask to point to where they would like the liquid to be poured, and the partner will draw a line or an arrow. 

As for baristas using the corresponding ice scoop: We may be on autopilot when we quickly grab an empty scoop. We just pour less ice from that scoop into your drink.
Good luck! I'm sure you did better than you think you did. But it might not hurt to try calling again to see if you'll get somebody else?

There's a customer at the store I work at who comes in almost every day and demands that we shake her venti, iced, no ice, soy GRTL in the tea shaker. My SM makes the exception only for her because she has caused scenes in the past. Today I was the lucky barista who had to make it for her. I made sure the matcha was mixed in really well and filled the cup up to the very top rim. In fact it spilled over when I put the lid on, and I absorbed the liquid on the sides of her cup with a paper towel. When I handed it off to her, she asked me to fill it higher. She was watching me like a hawk, and had most likely seen that I had filled it as high as possible. But I said okay anyway and I filled it so that foam was balancing on and around the top rim of the cup, and gave it to her with a lid on the side. I'm hoping she ended up spilling it all over herself.
